scope: Linux x64 raw temporary-directory environment paths, ordinary Lean creation and returned paths, independently checked physical file/directory locations, permissions and contents. Full Node/Deno/local rebuilt Bun and packaged released Node/Deno/stock Bun. Not full-suite or native cross-platform completion.
repair: Retain original POSIX bytes from the selected environment value through cwd anchoring, native mkostemp/mkstemp or mkdtemp, worker transport and the reply. Let Lean decode the returned path just as native Lean does. No new Lean API.
nativeBehavior: Native Lean itself returns a lossy-decoded FilePath for a malformed-byte pathname. That returned spelling may not locate the object just created. Lasm now matches that behavior, while creation uses the original raw directory. Only the external test harness cleans up byte-named entries.
